reason: An event-driven session guardian that monitors assertion patterns, edit review status, and feedback-loop behavior, then provides reminders and UI snapshots.

summaries.zh: 用于监控会话中的断言、编辑复核队列和反馈循环，并提供动态提醒与界面快照。
summaries.en: Monitors session assertions, edit review status, and feedback-loop behavior while providing dynamic reminders and UI snapshots.

capabilities: Monitors assistant messages and session events for assertion patterns
Tracks edit-only turns and successful write/edit calls
Maintains a bounded review queue and per-session state in JSON storage
Provides session and review-queue snapshots for UI panels
